description: Builds, integrates, and troubleshoots Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform Live API (BidiGenerateContent) WebSocket clients and sessions. Use when scaffolding a LiveAPI client or demo UI/backend (GA v1 WebSockets, isolated Python venv, ADC bearer token refresh, transparent session resumption, ClientMessage and ServerMessage JSON protos, tool responses, context_update, interrupt and transcription handling) or debugging Live API issues such as silent or empty turns, audio amplitude collapse, tonal humming, voice gender or accent drift, premature turn completion, barge-in failures, output_transcription leaks, malformed or looping tool calls, WebSocket 1008/1011/goAway drops, or latency spikes. Don't use for non-live, non-bidirectional Gemini API calls such as unary generateContent, embeddings, image/video generation, or fine-tuning — use the gemini-api skill for those.
